jobs.title: Senior Lead Treasury Management Consultant
jobs.description:
At Wells Fargo, we are looking for talented people who will put our customers at the center of everything we do. Help us build a better Wells Fargo. It all begins with outstanding talent. It all begins with you.

Learn more about the career areas and lines of business at wellsfargojobs.com .

About this role:
Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Lead Treasury Management Consultant within Global Payments & Liquidity as part of Enterprise Functions.

In this role, you will:
- Act as an advisor to senior leadership to develop or influence Treasury Management Consulting objectives and long-term goals for highly complex business and technical needs across Treasury Management Consulting
- Lead the strategy and resolution of highly complex and unique challenges requiring in-depth evaluation across multiple business lines, delivering solutions that are long-term, large-scale and require advanced knowledge, inductive thinking, and coordination of highly complex activities and guidance to others
- Provide vision, direction, and expertise to senior leadership on implementing innovative and significant business solutions that are large-scale and cross functional
- Lead Treasury Management Consulting projects and teams, or serve as peer mentor
- Strategically engage with all levels of professionals and managers across the enterprise and serve as an expert advisor to leadership

Required Qualifications:
- 7+ years of Treasury Management Sales experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

Desired Qualifications:
- Strong understanding of payables and receivables processes, including workflow optimization and cash‑flow impacts

- Proven experience managing high volumes of sales calls with a strategic approach to planning, execution, and anticipating customer needs while delivering a high‑touch client experience

- Proactive, self‑driven approach with the ability to consult, engage, and influence prospects in a fast‑paced environment

- Excellent partnership and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence cross‑functional teams and remain receptive to feedback

- Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail; capable of managing multiple deals, priorities, and internal partners simultaneously

- Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to translate complex treasury concepts for diverse audiences

- Experience working with Emerging Middle Market clients ($25MM–$100MM revenue) and familiarity with treasury platforms, payment technologies, and fraud‑mitigation solutions

- CTP (Certified Treasury Professional) designation or willingness to pursue

Job Expectations:
- Hybrid Scheduled (3 days in office and 2 remote each week)

- Ability to travel up to 50% of the time

jobs.title: Strategy Consultant
jobs.description:
About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Strategy Consultant to join the Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB) Strategy team. Learn more about the career areas and business divisions at wellsfargojobs.com.

The team works directly with CIB senior leadership to shape and drives the firm’s most important strategic priorities across Banking, Markets, Commercial Real Estate (CRE), and enterprise‑level initiatives. The team partners closely with business heads and senior stakeholders to evaluate growth opportunities, allocate capital, manage risk, and improve returns across the franchise.

This role is ideal for candidates with experience in top‑tier management consulting and/or investment banking, private credit, or private equity who are looking to operate at the center of decision‑making within a leading global financial institution. The Consultant will support strategy development and execution across a wide range of topics, including business growth, portfolio and capital allocation decisions, operating model evolution, and cross‑LOB initiatives. The role offers significant exposure to senior leadership and the opportunity to have direct impact on the direction of the CIB.

In this role, you will:
- Partner with CIB senior leadership to define, evaluate, and execute strategic priorities across Banking, Markets, CRE, and Enterprise initiatives.
- Conduct rigorous quantitative and qualitative analysis to support decisions related to growth strategy, capital deployment, risk appetite, and returns optimization.
- Develop clear, concise, executive‑ready materials for senior leadership, including presentations for management committees, operating reviews, and board‑level discussions.
- Collaborate closely with business leaders, finance, risk, and other stakeholders to translate strategy into executable initiatives.
- Support critical initiatives such as portfolio reviews, new business assessments, M&A evaluation, and cross‑LOB coordination efforts.
- Synthesize insights from internal performance data, market analysis, and external benchmarks to inform leadership decision‑making.
- Manage workstreams independently while balancing multiple priorities in a fast‑paced, high‑visibility environment.

Required Qualifications:
- 4+ years of Strategy and Planning experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education.

Desired Qualifications:
- Undergraduate or graduate degrees in analytic fields (e.g., Economics, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics).
- Top‑tier management consulting (e.g., McKinsey, Bain, BCG), and / or Investment Banking, Private Credit, and / or Private Equity experience.
- Bachelor’s degree from a top academic institution.
- Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to structure complex issues and develop clear, actionable insights.
- Demonstrated experience building high‑quality, senior‑level presentations and written communications.
- Comfort working with senior stakeholders and navigating cross‑functional teams.
- Strong judgment, intellectual curiosity, and a bias toward impact and execution.

jobs.description:
About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking an International Tax Operations professional (VP) to join the Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB) Core Services Tax Operations team.
In this role, you will provide subject matter expertise and operational leadership across customer tax information reporting, international tax compliance, withholding tax, transaction tax, capital gains tax, and regulatory reporting obligations. You will partner with stakeholders across Tax, Legal, Compliance, Technology, Operations, Corporate Actions, and business teams to deliver controlled, scalable solutions that support regulatory compliance, operational excellence, and business growth.
As a senior member of the team, you will lead complex initiatives supporting the end-to-end tax reporting lifecycle while helping to strengthen governance frameworks, enhance operational resilience, and drive continuous improvement across a dynamic international tax landscape. This role offers significant exposure to senior stakeholders and the opportunity to influence strategic initiatives across EMEA Tax Operations.
At Wells Fargo, we value strong risk management, collaboration, accountability, and inclusion. You will join a team committed to delivering operational excellence while supporting business growth and maintaining a strong control environment.

In this role, you will:
- Lead complex initiatives supporting the end-to-end customer tax information reporting lifecycle, including tax documentation, account classification, withholding, transaction tax, regulatory reporting, client communications, corrections, remediation, and process enhancements.
- Provide subject matter expertise across international tax operations, including FATCA, Common Reporting Standard (CRS), Chapter 3 and Chapter 4 withholding and reporting, Financial Transaction Tax (FTT), capital gains tax, Irish Deposit Interest Retention Tax (DIRT), and other applicable jurisdictional requirements.
- Serve as a key partner for EMEA Tax Operations, collaborating with Operations, Tax, Legal, Compliance, Technology, Corporate Actions, and business stakeholders to support strategic priorities and regulatory obligations.
- Lead the operational application and oversight of Financial Transaction Tax requirements, including transaction assessment, tax determination, reconciliation, reporting, and exception management.
- Partner with Corporate Actions teams to assess taxable events and determine the appropriate application of transaction tax, withholding tax, capital gains tax, and other jurisdiction-specific tax requirements.
- Oversee operational processes supporting capital gains tax and DIRT obligations, including documentation validation, tax treatment assessments, reporting, reconciliation, and issue resolution.
- Lead the review and resolution of complex customer tax documentation and reporting exceptions, including entity classification matters, reportability determinations, tax identification issues, withholding discrepancies, and tax form deficiencies.
- Assess the impact of regulatory, policy, product, client, market, corporate action, and technology changes, translating requirements into operational procedures, controls, testing strategies, and implementation plans.
- Lead data analysis, reconciliations, and root-cause investigations across multiple systems and reporting platforms to improve data quality, reporting accuracy, and operational effectiveness.
- Lead operational governance activities, including issue management, escalation, control enhancement, management reporting, and remediation of regulatory and operational risks.
- Support regulatory reporting production and readiness activities, including data validation, exception management, filing support, corrections, and responses to internal and external inquiries.
- Drive automation and process improvement initiatives that enhance scalability, strengthen controls, improve transparency, and reduce manual effort.
- Influence and lead cross-functional teams to deliver initiatives across multiple products, platforms, markets, and jurisdictions.
- Act as a senior operational resource and escalation point, providing guidance on complex tax matters while promoting the consistent application of policies, procedures, and control standards.

Required Qualifications
- Experience in customer tax information reporting, international tax operations, tax documentation, withholding tax, transaction taxes, capital gains tax, or regulatory reporting within financial services.
- Strong knowledge of FATCA, CRS, Chapter 3 and Chapter 4 withholding and reporting requirements, Financial Transaction Tax, capital gains tax, Irish DIRT, and related customer due diligence and reporting obligations.
- Experience assessing the tax implications of corporate actions and applying transaction tax, withholding tax, capital gains tax, or other tax treatments to client positions and proceeds.
- Experience supporting institutional products and services, including securities, derivatives, custody, securities lending, prime brokerage, or other capital markets products.
- Strong analytical skills with experience reviewing large data sets, performing reconciliations, identifying root causes, and driving resolution of complex issues.
- Experience with operational risk management, control design, issue management, audit reviews, regulatory examinations, and governance frameworks.
- Experience leading regulatory change initiatives, process transformation, system implementations, user acceptance testing, or automation projects.
- Ability to communicate complex tax and operational concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
- Strong leadership, stakeholder management, prioritization, and written and verbal communication skills.

Job Expectations
- Operate with a strong focus on accuracy, timeliness, customer impact, regulatory compliance, and effective risk management.
- Manage sensitive customer and tax information in accordance with applicable privacy, information security, records management, and access-control requirements.
- Support time-sensitive reporting cycles, corporate action events, production activities, issue remediation efforts, and regulatory or audit requests as business needs require.

jobs.title: Off-Cycle M&A Intern Analyst
jobs.description:
About this Role

Wells Fargo is seeking an Off‑Cycle M&A Analyst Intern to join our Investment Banking team in Paris. This six‑month internship offers the opportunity to gain hands‑on experience within a dynamic Mergers & Acquisitions environment and to contribute directly to live transaction work, strategic analysis, and client materials.

The Role

As an Off‑Cycle M&A Analyst Intern, you will support the Paris M&A team across market analysis, valuation exercises, and execution deliverables. You will work closely with Analysts, Associates, Vice Presidents, Directors, and Managing Directors across Paris, London, and the U.S. as part of an integrated deal team.

You will contribute to live mandates as well as strategic advisory assignments, preparing analytical materials, financial models, and client presentations. You will be treated as an integral team member, expected to demonstrate initiative, rigour, and a strong commitment to high‑quality work.

Key Responsibilities

- Gather and synthesise financial and operating information on companies, industries, and markets.
- Create, update, and maintain financial models (DCF, comparable companies, precedent transactions).
- Collect and analyse market data to support valuations and transaction recommendations.
- Draft presentations and memoranda for internal and external audiences.
- Assist in the preparation of client materials, including pitchbooks and transaction documents.
- Support live transaction processes, including due diligence, data‑room review, and coordination with stakeholders.
- Participate in team discussions and, where appropriate, attend client meetings or calls.
- Contribute to research on market trends, strategic themes, and relevant M&A activity.

Required Qualifications

- Excellent academic record from a business school / university in France / Europe
- Master’s student — either on a gap year or admitted post‑bachelor — specialising in Finance, Economics, or Banking
- Work experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, education

Desired Qualifications

- Ability to work effectively in a team environment and across all organizational levels, where flexibility, collaboration, and adaptability are important
- Strong analytical skills with high attention to detail and accuracy
- Ability to execute in a fast paced, high demand, environment while balancing multiple priorities
- Proficient Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint) skills
- Have a keen interest in Financial Markets
- Fluency in French and English
- Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to articulate ideas clearly and concisely

À propos de ce poste

Wells Fargo recherche un stagiaire en Fusions-Acquisitions pour rejoindre son équipe à Paris. Ce stage de six mois offre l’opportunité d’acquérir une expérience concrète au sein d’un environnement dynamique en Fusions-Acquisitions, et de contribuer directement à des transactions en cours, à des analyses stratégiques et à la préparation de documents destinés aux clients.

Description du poste

Ce poste consiste à soutenir l’équipe M&A de Paris dans les analyses de marché, les travaux de valorisation et les missions liées à l’exécution de transactions, en collaboration étroite avec des équipes composées d’Analystes, d’Associates, de Vice Presidents, de Directors et de Managing Directors à Paris, Londres et aux États‑Unis.

Ce poste implique une participation active aux mandats en cours ainsi qu’aux missions de conseil stratégique, notamment à travers la préparation d’analyses, de modèles financiers et de présentations destinées aux clients, avec un haut niveau d’exigence en matière de rigueur, d’initiative et de qualité du travail.

Dans le cadre de ce poste, vous devrez

- Collecter et synthétiser des informations financières et opérationnelles sur des entreprises, des secteurs et des marchés
- Elaborer, mettre à jour et maintenir des modèles financiers (DCF, étude des transactions comparables et de comparables boursiers)
- Collecter et analyser des données de marché afin d’appuyer les travaux de valorisation et l’exécution de transactions
- Rédiger des présentations et des mémorandums d’informations destinés à des audiences internes et externes
- Participer à la préparation de documents destinés aux clients, notamment des pitchbooks et des documents liés aux transactions
- Contribuer aux processus d’exécution des transactions en cours, incluant les missions de due diligence, l’organisation de datarooms et la coordination avec les différentes parties prenantes
- Participer aux échanges au sein de l’équipe et, le cas échéant, assister à des réunions avec les clients
- Contribuer aux travaux de recherche sur les tendances de marché, les thématiques stratégiques et l’activité M&A pertinente

Qualifications requises

- Excellent parcours académique au sein d’une université ou d’une école de commerce de premier rang en France ou en Europe
- Étudiant(e) en Master, en année de césure ou admis(e) en Master après un cycle Bachelor, avec une spécialisation en finance, économie ou banque
- Expérience professionnelle, ou équivalent démontré par l’un ou une combinaison des éléments suivants : expérience professionnelle, formation, études

Qualifications souhaitées

- Aisance dans le travail en équipe et dans les interactions avec l’ensemble des niveaux de l’organisation, dans un environnement nécessitant flexibilité, collaboration et adaptabilité
- Solides compétences analytiques, avec une attention élevée portée aux détails et à la précision
- Aptitude à évoluer dans un environnement exigeant et à rythme soutenu, en gérant efficacement plusieurs priorités simultanément
- Très bonne maîtrise des outils Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook et PowerPoint)
- Intérêt marqué pour les marchés financiers

- Excellentes qualités de communication écrite et orale, avec une aptitude à exprimer des idées de manière claire et structurée

jobs.title: VP, Commercial Banking Relationship Manager - Emerging Middle Market
jobs.description:
About this role:
Wells Fargo is seeking a driven and entrepreneurial Vice President, Commercial Banking Relationship Manager to lead business development efforts within our Emerging Middle Market Banking segment, serving companies with annual revenues of $25 million to $100 million. This is an opportunity for a proven commercial banker who thrives on creating new relationships, uncovering opportunities, and helping growing businesses achieve their strategic objectives.

This RM will focus on building a franchise across the Virginia market through proactive prospecting, network development, and consultative client engagement. The ideal candidate is a strong business developer with established market credibility, sound credit acumen, and a demonstrated ability to win new client relationships while delivering the full capabilities of Wells Fargo to clients and prospects. This role is aligned to the Virginia market and will focus on privately held, family-owned, sponsor-backed, and growth-oriented businesses throughout the state.

In this role, you will:
- Develop and execute a strategic business development plan to acquire and grow relationships with Emerging Middle Market companies throughout Virginia
- Build a consistent pipeline through prospecting, networking, referrals, centers of influence, and active participation in the local business community
- Establish trusted advisor relationships with business owners, executives, private equity sponsors, attorneys, CPAs, and other key decisionmakers
- Structure, negotiate, and execute commercial banking solutions, including cash flow lending, commercial real estate financing, treasury management, and other capital solutions
- Partner across Wells Fargo to deliver the firm's full suite of products and services, creating customized solutions that address complex client needs
- Lead relationship planning activities to deepen engagement and identify opportunities for growth
- Collaborate with credit partners and product specialists to develop and present comprehensive banking solutions
- Maintain strong sales discipline, pipeline management, and client activity within CRM systems
- Serve as a market ambassador for Wells Fargo, enhancing the firm's visibility and reputation throughout Virginia's business community
- Navigate complex client situations, manage risk appropriately, and ensure adherence to regulatory and compliance requirements

Required Qualifications:

- 5+ years of Commercial Banking Relationship Management experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
- Completion of a formal commercial credit training program with demonstrated proficiency in financial statement analysis, cash flow lending, credit underwriting, risk assessment, and loan structuring, or equivalent commercial credit experience

Desired Qualifications:
- Demonstrated success acquiring new commercial banking relationships and generating sustained revenue growth
- Experience serving companies with annual revenues between $25MM and $100MM
- Formal commercial credit training program completion or equivalent credit underwriting experience
- Strong understanding of commercial lending, treasury management, capital markets, and broader commercial banking solutions
- Ability to structure and discuss complex financing solutions with business owners, executive leadership teams, and financial sponsors

About this role:
Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Business Banking Relationship Manager (LO) to be part of our growing Business Banking Team. This role will support customers in an assigned market by deepening relationships and engaging in prospecting activities. - Source and onboard new business clients through strategic prospecting, community outreach, and internal referrals
- Build visibility and develop strong Centers of Influence (COIs) to support long-term relationship development
- Deepen existing relationships by understanding client priorities and proactively identifying opportunities for engagement and expansion
- Manage a moderately complex book of business
- Drive portfolio growth by increasing core deposit balances and identifying deepening opportunities
- Proactively manage risk exposure and ensure alignment with underwriting policies and risk guidelines

- Recommend and deliver a full suite of Wells Fargo business banking products including credit, treasury management, and digital banking tools
- Tailor solutions to client operating cycles, cash flow needs, and strategic goals
- Collaborate with product teams and internal stakeholders to creatively solve client challenges and streamline processes
- Engage financial decision-makers with proactive communication and responsive service
- Provide actionable feedback to enhance tools and offerings that elevate client experience and operational excellence
- Retain and grow client relationships by advising on financial strategies and managing expectations with transparency and care
- This LO position has customer contact and job duties which may include needs assessing and referring those customers interested in a dwelling secured product to a SAFE team member. Individuals in a LO position also must meet the Loan Originator requirements under Regulation Z (LO) outlined in the job expectations below

Required Qualifications:
- 4+ years of banking experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

- 2+ years of experience sourcing and or managing a portfolio of clients with $2mm - 25mm in annual revenue
- Strong knowledge of deposit and cash management products and services
- Strong relationship-building and excellent communication skills with individuals at all levels, internally and externally
- Ability to balances needs of clients with associated risks and interests of Wells Fargo
- 3+ years of experience in business-to-business sales
- Established network in the local market
- Knowledge and understanding of financial services industry

jobs.description:
About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Strategic Sourcing Consultant to join the Corporate Services Strategic Sourcing team, part of the Chief Administrative Office (CAO). This role will support Marketing, Brand Management, and Public Affairs sourcing initiatives, with a primary focus on direct print, direct mail, print production, mailing services, fulfillment, and related marketing execution services.

In this role, you will:

Lead Sourcing Strategy and Category Management
- Lead end-to-end sourcing activities for complex Marketing, Brand Management, and Public Affairs supplier engagements, including direct print, direct mail, print production, mailing services, fulfillment, communications, public relations, research, events, sponsorships, and related marketing execution services.
- Develop and execute category strategies for direct print and direct mail services, including offset and digital printing, variable data printing, personalization, prepress, proofing, finishing, kitting, warehousing, fulfillment, postal optimization, and campaign execution.
- Assess direct print and direct mail supplier portfolios to identify opportunities for supplier consolidation, print specification standardization, volume leverage, postal savings, improved cycle times, quality management, and service model optimization.
- Review expiring agreements and support timely renewals or competitive sourcing events while identifying opportunities for cost reduction, supplier consolidation, service improvements, sustainability, and value creation.

Contract Negotiation & Commercial Management
- Lead supplier negotiations, including category and negotiation strategy development, vendor communications, proposal evaluations, and award recommendations.
- Negotiate commercial models for print production and direct mail services, including unit pricing, rate cards, volume tiers, postage pass-throughs, paper and substrate costs, inventory management, storage, fulfillment, kitting, mailing services, service-level commitments, renewal caps, and price adjustment mechanisms.
- Negotiate contract provisions supporting secure and compliant handling of customer and campaign data, including data use limitations, address list management, privacy obligations, print file controls, chain-of-custody expectations, quality assurance, and incident notification requirements.
- Negotiate commercial, operational, legal, governance, and risk-related terms while balancing stakeholder objectives, business timelines, and enterprise risk requirements.
- Draft, review, and manage contract language to address evolving business, regulatory, operational, brand, and market requirements.

Supplier Relationship & Risk Management
- Manage strategic supplier relationships throughout the contract lifecycle, driving performance, customer satisfaction, service improvements, and value realization.
- Partner with Legal, Information Security, Third Party Risk Management, and Finance to support compliance with corporate policies, regulatory requirements, and risk management standards.
- Evaluate supplier controls, including data security, physical security, print production controls, quality assurance procedures, proofing and approval workflows, business continuity, subcontractor oversight, and handling of customer or campaign data.
- Resolve supplier disputes and proactively address supplier performance or risk concerns.

Stakeholder Partnership & Governance
- Build and maintain relationships with business partners, senior leaders, suppliers, and key stakeholders.
- Partner with business units to define requirements, execute RFx events, evaluate suppliers, and support vendor selection decisions.
- Drive stakeholder alignment on sourcing strategies, supplier recommendations, contract terms, risk decisions, and implementation plans.
- Serve as a central point of coordination for sourcing initiatives across multiple business groups.

Compliance, Reporting & Implementation
- Ensure contracts and sourcing activities comply with applicable legal, regulatory, and corporate requirements, including data privacy laws, customer communications standards, brand guidelines, postal requirements, supplier risk management expectations, and requirements impacting the handling of customer, campaign, and mailing data.
- Lead projects supporting regulatory compliance and sourcing process improvements.
- Track, communicate, and report sourcing progress, realized value, risk considerations, and implementation readiness.

Leadership & Subject Matter Expertise
- Provide guidance, coaching, and subject matter expertise to less experienced sourcing professionals, Buyers, and business partners.
- Serve as a trusted advisor for complex sourcing and supplier management decisions, including direct print and direct mail supplier landscape trends, pricing benchmarks, postal optimization, production capabilities, brand execution needs, and Public Affairs communications requirements.

Required Qualifications:
- 2+ years of sourcing or procurement experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

Desired Qualifications:
- Experience drafting, reviewing, interpreting, and negotiating complex commercial contracts, including contract terms, risk considerations, and commercial impacts.
- Sourcing and contract negotiation experience supporting Marketing, Brand Management, and Public Affairs categories, including direct print, direct mail, print production, fulfillment, communications, public relations, events, sponsorships, and related marketing execution services.
- Direct print and direct mail category experience, including offset printing, digital printing, variable data printing, prepress, proofing, color management, paper specifications, finishing, inserting, kitting, warehousing, fulfillment, and mailing services.
- Experience with direct mail supplier capabilities, including address list processing, NCOA updates, presort, commingling, Intelligent Mail Barcode tracking, postal optimization, delivery performance, and secure handling of customer mailing data.
- Knowledge of marketing execution and brand management supply chains, including creative production, print specifications, campaign versioning, personalization, quality control, inventory management, sustainability considerations, supplier performance metrics, and brand consistency requirements.
- Experience negotiating contract terms for print, mail, fulfillment, and communications suppliers, including service levels, quality standards, turnaround times, postal and freight cost treatment, inventory controls, subcontractor management, audit rights, confidentiality, data protection, and transition support.
- Proven success leading end-to-end strategic sourcing engagements and supplier negotiations within a large, complex, highly regulated organization.
- Ability to advise Marketing, Brand Management, and Public Affairs stakeholders on supplier strategy, contract structure, sourcing approach, print and direct mail production models, risk considerations, implementation readiness, and supplier performance opportunities.
- Strong commercial, financial, benchmarking, and spend analysis skills, including print specification analysis, volume consolidation, rate card evaluation, postage and freight analysis, supplier performance metrics, and pricing benchmarks.
- Ability to effectively manage cross-functional stakeholders, including Legal, Risk, Finance, Technology, Information Security, Third Party Risk Management, and senior business leaders.
- Knowledge of banking regulations, third-party risk management practices, supplier governance, data privacy regulations, customer communications requirements, postal compliance considerations, and regulatory requirements impacting supplier engagements and customer data use.
- Proficiency with strategic sourcing, procurement, and contract lifecycle management tools, including Ariba, RFx processes, e-auction platforms, spend analytics, supplier scorecards, print and mail production reporting, and benchmarking tools.
- Excellent relationship-building, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to quickly establish credibility and drive consensus.
- Strong project management, time management, analytical, and organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Strategic Sourcing Consultant to join the Corporate Services Strategic Sourcing Team as part of the Chief Administrative Office (CAO), with primary support for Marketing and Public Affairs technology sourcing initiatives. This role serves as the strategic sourcing subject matter expert for the enterprise marketing technology (MarTech) and advertising technology (AdTech) ecosystem, including AI-enabled marketing platforms, customer data infrastructure, and digital media supply chains.

In this role, you will:

Lead Sourcing Strategy & MarTech Category Management
- Lead end-to-end sourcing lifecycle activities for complex, high-risk, and strategic Marketing and Public Affairs supplier engagements, including marketing technology (MarTech), advertising technology (AdTech), digital media, creative services, communications, research, events, sponsorships, and related technology-enabled services.
- Develop and execute category strategies across the MarTech stack — enterprise marketing clouds, customer data platforms (CDPs), customer engagement and journey orchestration, marketing analytics and attribution, content and digital asset management, personalization, and generative AI marketing tools — that optimize costs, improve supplier performance, mitigate risk, and support enterprise business objectives.
- Lead MarTech stack assessment and rationalization initiatives, identifying overlapping capabilities, underutilized licenses, and consolidation opportunities across the marketing technology portfolio.
- Review expiring Marketing and Public Affairs agreements, identify opportunities for supplier consolidation, service improvements, cost reduction, and value creation, and support timely renewals or competitive sourcing events.

Contract Negotiation & Commercial Management
- Lead all aspects of supplier negotiations, including development of MarTech category and negotiation strategies, vendor communications, proposal evaluations, and award recommendations.
- Negotiate modern SaaS and consumption-based commercial models, including monthly-active-user (MAU), message-volume, credit-based, and usage-based pricing structures, true-up mechanics, renewal caps, service credits, and professional services terms.

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Compliance Officer to join the Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB) Markets Compliance team. Reporting to the Head of Equities Compliance, this role will provide second-line compliance oversight for the Futures Commission Merchant (FCM) activities of Wells Fargo Securities, LLC.

This position plays a critical role in overseeing and advancing the Futures Commission Merchant (FCM) compliance program. This senior product leader will manage a team and own the multi‑year compensation product strategy, ensuring solutions are scalable, compliant, transparent, and aligned with WIM business objectives and enterprise risk expectations.

This role serves as the single point of accountability to align strategy, funding, delivery, and governance for compensation products—driving modernization, consistency, and operational excellence in a highly regulated environment. The leader will collaborate extensively with Product Owners, HR, Finance, Field Leadership, Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Technology to deliver a cohesive compensation ecosystem that supports advisor engagement, retention, and long‑term growth.

About this role:
Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Lead Technology Risk Officer .

The Technology Governance, Risk & Controls Oversight Leader provides independent second-line oversight and credible challenge of technology governance, risk management, and control programs. This role evaluates the effectiveness of governance frameworks, risk management practices, control environments, regulatory compliance programs, operational resilience capabilities, and strategic technology initiatives. The successful candidate will help ensure technology risks are appropriately identified, assessed, monitored, and mitigated in alignment with enterprise standards, risk appetite, and regulatory expectations.

As a Senior Lead Technology Risk Officer, this individual will influence enterprise technology risk strategy, provide oversight of critical technology and AI initiatives, engage with executive leadership, and contribute to strengthening the organization's overall technology risk governance framework.

In this role, you will:
- Provide independent oversight and credible challenge of technology governance frameworks, decision-making processes, and accountability structures.
- Evaluate the effectiveness of governance committees, reporting forums, and escalation processes in supporting informed risk-based decisions.

jobs.title: Senior Business Execution Consultant - GIS Branch Banking Analyst
jobs.description:
About this role

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Business Execution Consultant to support Branch Distribution Strategy & Analytics. This role will combine Geographic Information Systems (GIS), business analytics, and product ownership to support strategic decisions across the retail branch network.

The individual will manage the day-to-day business ownership and continued development of the team’s internal webmap product while conducting geospatial and quantitative analyses. By combining branch, customer, competitor, demographic, financial, and market data, this role will deliver actionable insights and recommendations related to branch openings, closures, relocations, market coverage, and overall network optimization.

The successful candidate will translate complex location data into clear business recommendations, develop reusable analytical tools and workflows, and partner with Strategy, Finance, Data Science, Operations, Technology, and other stakeholders to move recommendations into execution.

In this role, you will:

- Own the business roadmap, requirements, testing, documentation, and continuous improvement of the team's internal webmap product.
- Structure ambiguous business questions and determine the appropriate analytical approach to support strategic decision-making.
- Analyze large and complex datasets using GIS and analytical tools to identify opportunities, risks, and performance trends.
- Translate analytical findings into executive-ready presentations, maps, visualizations, and business recommendations.
- Lead support functions or operations for multiple business groups and contribute to large-scale strategic initiatives.
- Ensure the efficiency, quality, and cost effectiveness of solutions and pipeline management related to assigned operations.
- Research moderately complex business, operational, and strategic initiatives requiring analytical skills, knowledge of organizational strategy and Business Execution, and an understanding of international business.
- Work independently to develop recommendations for support functions while providing support and leadership.
- Assist in planning and executing programs and initiatives that may include risk mitigation, efficiency, and customer experience.
- Collaborate and consult with team leaders to develop project plans, policies, and procedures.
- Provide leadership in managing relationships and implementing programs, services, and initiatives with cross-functional business partners.

Required Qualifications:

- 4+ years of Business Execution, Implementation, or Strategic Planning experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, or education.
- 4+ years of experience in GIS, spatial analytics, geographic data analysis, retail network planning, market analytics, real estate analytics, or related analytical disciplines.
- 4+ years of experience building reports, dashboards, visualizations, and executive presentations using analytical tools and business intelligence platforms.
- 2+ years of experience analyzing large, complex datasets and translating findings into actionable business recommendations.

Desired Qualifications:

- Experience using GIS platforms such as Esri ArcGIS, ArcGIS Pro, or comparable geospatial tools.
- Experience supporting retail banking, financial services, branch distribution, or multi-site retail organizations.
- Experience evaluating branch locations, trade areas, market potential, or real estate portfolio strategies.
- Advanced knowledge of demographic, consumer, and geographic data sources.
- Experience with spatial modeling, predictive analytics, and market forecasting.
- Knowledge of SQL, Python, R, Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytical tools.
- Ability to simplify complex analytical concepts for executive audiences.
- Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.
- Experience presenting recommendations to senior leadership and influencing business decisions.
- Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to support strategic business initiatives.

- Ability to work a hybrid schedule, onsite three days per week.
- Ability to travel up to 5%.

jobs.description:
About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Lead Technology Business Systems Consultant who will serve as the Product Transformation Leader. This person will serve as a key member of the Chief Operation Office (COO) Technology Transformation Office and is responsible for defining, implementing, and scaling the product-centric operating model across COO Technology.

This role helps shape how the organization prioritizes, organizes, funds, governs, and delivers work to achieve measurable business outcomes. The individual will drive transformation initiatives that improve role clarity, accountability, decision-making, product effectiveness, delivery execution, and value realization across portfolios and products.

Acting as a strategic partner to business and technology leaders, this individual will establish operating model standards, improve alignment between Product and Technology organizations, optimize organizational structures and product governance, and drive adoption of product-centric ways of working. The role will also ensure transformation efforts produce measurable business outcomes through value realization frameworks, product effectiveness measures, and operational performance improvements.

The Product Operating Model & Value Realization Leader will play a critical role in helping COO Technology evolve into a more product-centric, AI-enabled, and outcome-oriented organization.

In this role you will:

- Lead the design, implementation, and continuous evolution of the COO Technology Product Operating Model, improving delivery effectiveness, governance maturity, and alignment to strategic business objectives.
- Partner with Product, Technology, Operations, and Business leaders to optimize organizational structures, product-to-engineering alignment, and operating rhythms, increasing transparency and execution effectiveness.
- Establish product governance, portfolio management, and operating model standards that improve product maturity, strengthen accountability, and drive consistent adoption across the organization.
- Define and implement value realization frameworks that measure business impact, track benefits delivery, and ensure product investments are aligned to enterprise priorities and customer outcomes.

- Redesign cross-functional structures, decision paths, and ways of working across Product, Technology, Operations, and Business teams—moving beyond the management of transformation activities to remove barriers, accelerate execution, and demonstrate sustained outcomes.

- Develop governance and prioritization frameworks that improve investment decisions, resource allocation, and leadership visibility into portfolio performance and transformation progress.
- Advise executive leadership on strategic tradeoffs, operating model improvements, and continuous improvement opportunities to enhance organizational agility, decision quality, and business value delivery.

Required Qualifications:

- 7+ years of Business Systems Data and Business Systems Designing experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
- 6+ years of experience in product management, operating model transformation, business transformation, organizational effectiveness, strategy, consulting, or related disciplines.

Desired Qualifications:

- Experience implementing or scaling product-centric operating models in large organizations.
- Strong understanding of product management, Agile delivery, organizational design, governance, and business transformation.
- Experience partnering with senior business and technology leaders to drive organizational change.
- Strong facilitation, influence, and stakeholder management skills.
- Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and align diverse stakeholder groups.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and business transformation capabilities.
- Excellent communication and executive presentation skills.
- Experience with Product-to-Technology transformation initiatives.
- Knowledge of product maturity models, product governance, and portfolio management practices.
- Experience with value realization frameworks and business outcome measurement.
- Experience supporting workforce modernization or AI-enabled transformation initiatives.
- Familiarity with organizational effectiveness, role design, and operating model optimization.
- Consulting, strategy, product management, or transformation leadership background.

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Business Banking Relationship Manager (LO) to be part of our growing Business Banking Team. This role will support customers in an assigned local market by deepening relationships and engaging in prospecting activities. Learn more about the career areas and lines of business at wellsfargojobs.com.

In this role, you will:
- Source and onboard new business clients through strategic prospecting, community outreach, and internal referrals
- Build visibility and develop strong Centers of Influence (COIs) to support long-term relationship development
- Deepen existing relationships by understanding client priorities and proactively identifying opportunities for engagement and expansion
- Manage a moderately complex book of business
- Drive portfolio growth by increasing core deposit balances and identifying deepening opportunities
- Proactively manage risk exposure and ensure alignment with underwriting policies and risk guidelines
- Conduct comprehensive financial and credit assessments including cash flow, collateral, and business operating cycles
- Structure and support secured and unsecured credit solutions within delegated authority, coordinating with credit partners as needed
- Present credit recommendations and financial strategies to clients and internal stakeholders
- Recommend and deliver a full suite of Wells Fargo business banking products including credit, treasury management, and digital banking tools
- Tailor solutions to client operating cycles, cash flow needs, and strategic goals
- Collaborate with product teams and internal stakeholders to creatively solve client challenges and streamline processes
- Engage financial decision-makers with proactive communication and responsive service
- Provide actionable feedback to enhance tools and offerings that elevate client experience and operational excellence
- Retain and grow client relationships by advising on financial strategies and managing expectations with transparency and care
- This LO position has customer contact and job duties which may include needs assessing and referring those customers interested in a dwelling secured product to a SAFE team member. This position includes assisting customers without taking an application and without offering or negotiating terms of a dwelling secured transaction. Individuals in a LO position also must meet the Loan Originator requirements under Regulation Z (LO) outlined in the job expectations below

Required Qualifications:
- 4+ years of banking experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

Desired Qualifications:
- 2+ years of experience sourcing and or managing a portfolio of clients with $2mm - 25mm in annual revenue
- Strong knowledge of deposit and cash management products and services
- Strong relationship-building and excellent communication skills with individuals at all levels, internally and externally
- Ability to balances needs of clients with associated risks and interests of Wells Fargo
- 3+ years of experience in business-to-business sales
- Established network in the local market
- Knowledge and understanding of financial services industry
- Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
- Intermediate Microsoft Office skills
- A BS/BA degree or higher

Job Expectations:
- Position will be responsible for visiting customers and prospects outside of the branch location within an assigned market/geography.
- Individuals in Loan Originator (LO) positions must meet the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau qualification requirements and comply with related Wells Fargo policies. The LO qualification requirements include meeting applicable financial responsibility, character, general financial fitness and criminal background standards. A current credit report will be used to assess your financial responsibility and credit fitness, however, a credit score is not included as part of the evaluation. Successful candidates must also meet ongoing regulatory requirements including additional screening, if necessary

Posting Location:
- 550 S 4th St. Minneapolis, MN 55415

Pay Range

Reflected is the base pay range offered for this position. Pay may vary depending on factors including but not limited to demonstrated examples of prior performance, skills, experience, or work location. Employees may also be eligible for incentive opportunities.
$96,000.00 - $154,000.00

- Tuition reimbursement

jobs.title: Associate, Sponsor Credit - Technology Finance
jobs.description:
About this role:
Wells Fargo is seeking an Associate to join its Technology Finance team within the Commercial Bank’s Sponsor Credit group, an industry leader in delivering innovative financing solutions. This role will be part of a dedicated team responsible for underwriting and portfolio management within the software/technology vertical. Learn more about the career areas and lines of business at wellsfargojobs.com .

In this role, you will:
- In partnership with a senior portfolio manager, assist with portfolio management and credit underwriting activities for an assigned portfolio of technology-focused and primarily sponsor-backed clients, including performing transaction due diligence, financial analysis and modeling, credit analysis and monitoring, industry analysis, enterprise valuation, and credit memoranda preparation
- Engage in regular client interaction and relationship management with CEO, CFO and private equity sponsor for assigned portfolio.  Collaborate with internal partners in commercial and investment banking to develop and execute on relationship plans, and join meetings when relevant
- Review credit agreements and other relevant loan documentation while assisting with legal diligence and negotiation.  Over time, develop a proficiency in structuring, negotiating and documenting facility agreements
- Regularly present credit and financial analysis to business leadership and independent risk management (IRM) in a variety of forums, including recurring portfolio reviews, pre-screen discussions and credit/approval committees.  Develop strong and proficient written and verbal presentation skills
- Participate in business and enterprise-wide strategic initiatives, including ad-hoc specialized projects that arise from time to time to improve and enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the team
- Collaborate with peers and functional partners and develop internal relationships that will facilitate and enhance your role effectiveness.  As generative AI tools proliferate, leverage internal AI platforms to improve efficiency and apply best practices

Required Qualifications, US:
- 2+ years of Mid-Corporate Portfolio Management experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

Desired Qualifications:
- Experience in sponsor finance at a commercial bank, investment bank or finance company
- Excellent proficiency in accounting and financial modeling
- Strong analytical skills, with heightened attention to detail and accuracy
- Strong verbal and written communication skills
- Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

Job Expectations:
- Ability to travel up to 10% of the time
- This position is not eligible for Visa sponsorship
- This position offers a hybrid work schedule
- Specific compliance policies may apply regarding outside activities or personal investing; affected employees will be expected to provide information to the Wells Fargo Personal Account Dealing Team and abide by applicable policy requirements if hired. Information will be shared about expectations during the recruitment process
- This position is subject to FINRA background screening requirements. Candidates must successfully complete and pass a background check prior to hire. In accordance with FINRA rules, individuals who are subject to statutory disqualification are not eligible to be associated with a FINRA-registered broker-dealer. Successful candidates must also meet and comply with ongoing regulatory obligations, which include periodic screening and mandatory reporting of certain incidents.

Locations:

jobs.title: EMEA Banking Summer Analyst
jobs.description:
Wells Fargo Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB) delivers a comprehensive suite of banking and financial solutions to over 15,000 corporate and institutional clients, including over 70% of the S&P 500.

A trusted partner to our clients, we provide corporate and transaction banking, commercial real estate lending and servicing, investment banking, equity and fixed income solutions including sales, trading, and research capabilities to corporate, commercial real estate, government, and institutional clients.

Programme Overview

Wells Fargo’s Banking internship offers the opportunity to support complex transactions and strategic advisory work for leading corporates and institutions. The programme is designed to introduce you to the core activities of investment banking within a collaborative and professional environment.

During this ten-week programme, you will join teams such as Investment Banking (Mergers and Acquisitions, Fund Finance or Debt Capital Markets and Advisory) as well as our Corporate Banking teams. These teams help clients raise debt and equity capital, pursue growth opportunities, and manage financing risk. You will work on research and analysis, assist with presentations, and gain exposure to the internal processes that support live deals. Training and mentorship are built into the programme to help you grow your technical knowledge and professional confidence.

Summer Analyst Programme 2027

The programme duration is 10 weeks starting in late June 2027 and is designed to provide you with the unique opportunity to discover our CIB business, culture, and how we collaborate to deliver solutions for our clients. The programme offers organised activities such as classroom training and networking opportunities to boost your professional development.

Banking and Capital Markets (“BCM”) Overview

The BCM team sits within Wells Fargo’s Corporate and Investment Bank and is dedicated to understanding the unique competitive and operating environments of our clients. Combining strong relationships and industry knowledge with superior capital markets and advisory capabilities, our team excels in delivering exceptional execution. BCM is organised across coverage and product teams, covering Corporate Banking, Financial Institutions, Fund Finance, and M&A, among others.

About this role:
Wells Fargo is seeking an Associate Customer Service Representative in Everyday Banking Find out why we’re the #1 financial services company to grow YOUR career. Apply today.

At Wells Fargo, an Associate Customer Service Representative serves as the front line in a high-volume, inbound call center, delivering timely support across a range of financial products and services. You will operate in a fast-paced, highly dynamic, and metric-driven environment as you provide timely and accurate information, address customer concerns, resolve issues, and support a positive customer experience.

In this role, you will:
- Respond to and resolve high volumes of inbound customer interactions across phone and digital channels, providing timely, accurate support
- Assist customers with inquiries, transactions, and service requests with empathy across financial products and services
- Deliver a positive customer experience through clear communication, empathy, and problem-solving
- Perform routine tasks by following established processes, procedures, and regulatory guidelines
- Navigate multiple systems to access information, document interactions, and complete transactions
- Escalate complex or higher-risk customer concerns to experienced colleagues or leadership when appropriate
- Collaborate with peers and internal partners to support timely issue resolution and customer satisfaction
- Review customer information for accuracy and completeness and maintain appropriate records

Required Qualifications:
- 6+ months of customer service, financial services or contact center support experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

Desired Qualifications:
- Experience delivering customer support in a contact center in the financial services industry
- Demonstrated customer service experience using active listening, effective communication, identifying customer needs, and customer understanding to resolve inquiries, address concerns, and build strong customer relationships
- Experience managing customer inquiries in a fast-paced, high-volume, metric-driven environment while maintaining professionalism, accuracy, and quality service
- Problem-solving skills with the ability to research issues, identify root causes, evaluate solutions, and deliver timely resolutions
- Attention to detail and ability to navigate multiple systems, applications, and search tools while maintaining accuracy and compliance with policies and procedures
- Experience collaborating with customers, business partners, and team members to achieve shared goals, resolve escalations, and deliver positive outcomes
- Demonstrated resilience, accountability, and adaptability when managing changing priorities, customer needs, and challenging situations

Job Expectations:
- This role is not eligible for Visa sponsorship​
- Must be able to attend full duration of required training period​
- Ability to work additional hours as needed ​

- Schedule may be eligible for a shift differential under the terms of the shift differential policy

- Must work on-site at the location posted

Training and Work Schedule:
- Training class starts on 12/7 for 7 weeks. Training hours are 8:30 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. Monday - Friday.  You are required to attend the full duration of this paid 7 weeks of training.
- We’re open from Sunday - Saturday, 6:00 a.m. – 10:00 pm (EST) . Your regular work schedule will be based on business need and will include working at least one weekend day and some holidays. Most schedules will be mid-shift or evening-shift.

About this role:
Wells Fargo is seeking a Technology Operations Analyst.

In this role, you will:
- Participate in initiatives and identify opportunities for technology operations
- Evaluate basic or tactical challenges that require research and evaluation
- Provide centralized command and control for major incident management, ensuring teams focus first on restoring business services
- Review, analyze and escalate issues from key metric analysis, event monitors, reported service deviations, and documented changes
- Develop knowledge business cycles and capabilities to assess the impact of technology events on the business and other support areas
- Reduce the impact of application and infrastructure failures on business delivery
- Engage various teams of trouble-shooters to assess system health and issues
- Present recommendations for resolving more complex situations
- Provide information to functional colleagues, internal partners and stakeholders

Required Qualifications:
- 2+ years of Technology Operations experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

Desired Qualifications:
- 2+ years of total work experience, with strong understanding of computer hardware, software, applications, operating systems, and basic networking concepts
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Problem solving skills – Ability to analyze and troubleshoot technical issues as wells as identify patterns and potential solutions
- Multi-tasking skills to manage multiple chats or handle phone and chat in parallel to support service levels
- Team collaboration – Being able to work effectively in a team environment and collaborate with other IT teams
- CompTIA A+, ITIL Basis V4 Certified
- Prior experience in customer service or technical support role

Job Expectations:
- Candidate must be amenable to work in McKinley Hill, Taguig City
